tabs.name: Area & Volume Test
tabs.content:
::: AREA CONVERSIONS TEST
::: Testing the new area conversion units

::: Area conversions from example worksheet
1000 square feet to square meters
500 cubic inches to liters
2.5 acres to square kilometers

::: Additional area conversions
1 square meter to square feet
1 acre to square meters
1 hectare to acres
100 square inches to square feet
1 square mile to acres

::: VOLUME CONVERSIONS TEST
::: Testing cubic volume units

::: Cubic conversions
1 cubic meter to liters
1000 cubic centimeters to liters
1 cubic foot to liters
100 cubic inches to cubic feet
1 cubic yard to cubic meters

::: Mixed volume conversions
1 gallon to cubic inches
1 liter to cubic centimeters
1000 milliliters to cubic centimeters

::: VERIFICATION CALCULATIONS
::: Manual verification of conversions
::: 1 square foot = 0.092903 square meters
1 * 0.092903

::: 1 cubic inch = 0.0163871 liters
1 * 0.0163871

::: 1 acre = 4046.86 square meters
1 * 4046.86
